Name: Fate Weaver
Author: macro191
Description:
[size=6][b][center][/center][/b][b][center]🌀 Fateweaver[/center][/b][/size][center][b]A Living Trait Evolution System for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]


[b]Final Update Note[/b]
Hey everyone,
This will be my final update for this mod. I want to thank everyone who has used it—it was truly created as a fun side project, and I'm glad it resonated with some of you.
Unfortunately, I've found that some in the modding community can be a little unwelcoming to newcomers, which has diminished my enthusiasm for continuing development
That said, the mod will remain available as-is. If anyone wants to take it over or continue development, feel free to reach out.
Thanks for everything!
[/center]Your playstyle shapes your destiny. In [i]Fateweaver[/i], your actions don’t just earn you gold—they reshape who you are. Awaken dormant powers, evolve through hardship, and bear the mark of your true path through a dynamic, stat-driven evolution system.



[b][size=5]✦ Features🛠 12 Unique Traits (New Traits Added!)
[/size][/b]Traits unlock and evolve based on your specific actions. Your progress is evaluated every 7 days (default), allowing your character to grow alongside your farm.
[list]
[*]⛏ [b]Stoneblood (Mining)[/b] — [i]Stone gathered.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] +3 Mining, +2 Speed, +1 Attack, +30 Stamina.
[/list][*]⚔ [b]Warborn (Combat)[/b] — [i]Monsters killed.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] +3 Attack, +2 Defense, +1 Speed, +30 Stamina.
[/list][*]🌊 [b]Ocean-Touched (Fishing)[/b] — [i]Fish caught in the rain.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] +3 Fishing, +2 Luck, +50 Stamina.
[/list][*]🌿 [b]Greenhand (Farming)[/b] — [i]Crop diversity.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] +3 Farming, +2 Speed, +1 Luck, +25 Stamina.
[/list][*]💰 [b]Fortune Seeker (Luck)[/b] — [i]Total gold earned.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] +3 Luck, +128 Magnetic Radius, +1 Defense.
[/list][*]🛡 [b]Iron Will (Survival)[/b] — [i]Damage taken.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] +3 Defense, +1 Attack, +50 Stamina.
[/list][*]💀 [b]Survivor (Survival)[/b] — [i]Times unconscious.[/i]

[/list][/list][size=5][b]

🧬 8 Hybrid Mutations[/b]
[/size]When you become dominant in two different archetypes, you may discover a rare hybrid mutation, such as:
[list]
[*]💎 [b]Bloodstone Warden[/b] (Mining + Combat)
[*]⛈ [b]Tempest Walker[/b] (Fishing + Sleep)
[*]👑 [b]Gilded Survivor[/b] (Luck + Survival)
[*]🌍 [b]Earthshaper[/b] (Mining + Farming)
[*]...and many more!
[/list]
🔥 Fate SurgeEvery day has a [b]12% chance[/b] to trigger a [b]Fate Surge[/b]. For 28 minutes, your dominant trait receives a [b]1.5x power boost[/b], manifesting as a blaze of inner power.

[b][size=5]
⚙ Configuration & Commands
[/size][/b]Fateweaver is highly customizable to fit your preferred pace.
[list]
[*][b]In-Game Menu:[/b] Full [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] support for easy adjustments.
[*][b]Evaluation Interval:[/b] Change how often your traits are reassessed (Default: 7 days).
[*][b]Difficulty Multiplier:[/b] Increase for a grueling journey or decrease for rapid evolution.
[*][b]Console Command:[/b] Type [code]/trait[/code] in the SMAPI console to see your current progress toward all traits.
[/list]

[b][size=5]📋 Requirements[/size][/b][list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game settings.
[/list][b][size=5]📝 Translation
[/size][/b]Full [b]i18n[/b] support is included. See [code]i18n/default.json[/code] to contribute a translation for your language!
